prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular sprite kit for the HERALD OF DEATH miniboss in a high-quality 16-bit arcade vertical shooter. Reference image is the existing bone-winged skull warship: retain its recognizable ivory skull, obsidian and gunmetal elongated armored fuselage, crimson engine/weapon accents and skeletal mechanical wings. Regenerate at vastly higher craft and detail, crisp pixel-art clusters and strong metal highlights, readable at small scale, top/front 3/4 orthographic view with nose and guns pointing DOWN toward the player. This must be an EXPLODED PARTS SHEET, not an assembled enemy, so all components are independently usable for animation. Transparent background. Square 1536x1536 canvas, 3 columns by 2 rows of equally sized spacious cells, no grid lines or labels. Six isolated fully finished components, no overlap between cells and 35px transparent gutters: top-left = central elongated armored body fuselage WITHOUT skull, wings, arms or guns, exposed neck socket at upper center and wing/arm sockets at sides, complete silhouette and plated tail; top-middle = ivory demonic skull HEAD ONLY with red eyes and small dark mechanical neck joint, no torso; top-right = LEFT articulated skeletal wing, complete from inner circular hinge to broad outer bone struts, wing stretches LEFT from its inner root on the right, bony blade feathers and dark hydraulic membrane; bottom-left = RIGHT skeletal wing mirroring the left design, stretches RIGHT from inner root on its left; bottom-middle = LEFT heavy articulated gun arm complete shoulder joint, segmented upper arm and large forward-facing downward cannon with crimson plasma chamber; bottom-right = RIGHT matching articulated gun arm, same orientation and size, mirrored mechanical contours. Consistent scale across the body, wings and arms so these assemble into one imposing bone-winged assault craft. Head can be large in its cell for detail. Make it original, menacing, dimensional and well-defined like premium arcade boss pixel art. No text, backdrop, ground shadows, assembled inset, duplicate head, effects blocking joints, or cropped parts. Genuine transparent alpha around EVERY component.
